lines.text: Succeed at wearing or doing something bold.
Not everyone can pull off that color.

data.mean: Succeed at wearing or doing something bold.
data.define: To manage something hard or bold, like a style.

example.text: Not everyone can pull off that color.

misuse.text: Don't say 'pull off' when you mean 'remove'.

data.l1_hook: 他に誰がそれを「pull off」できるかな？
data.l1_ex: 誰でもその色を「pull off」できるわけではない。
